digest.component_or_area: bug close workflow and ticket state reduction
propositions: Bug close reason is currently validated but not persisted, wasting user input; a bounded enum classification must be folded into reduced ticket state so it survives and is queryable.
The --class flag must be required on bug close transitions, with omission triggering nonzero exit and stderr naming allowed enum values.
The _fold_close_class helper must be invoked in both fork-winner and normal-update branches of process_status to ensure close_class surfaces into reduced state queryable by rebar show.
Validation guards exist at two sites (txn.py transition_core and transition_close.py _completion_precheck) and both must be updated to accept the new enum in place of free-text reason.

The enum vocabulary (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated, undetermined) must be documented and validated consistently across CLI and state reduction.
